result.title: Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches
result.comment: 39 pages, 7 figures; supplementary material in ancillary files. Under review at Scientific Reports. Code and artifacts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23676823
result.summary: Flagging uncertain histopathology patches for specialist review needs a confidence that is higher when the model is right. We test whether an open medical vision-language model emits one. MedGemma-27b-it and its base Gemma-3-27b-it were run zero-shot under one prompt on 10,004 PathMNIST validation patches and 7,180 patches of a patient-disjoint external cohort. Both are too inaccurate to deploy (40.6% and 35.5%); the object of study is the confidence. MedGemma's verbalized confidence puts 96% of patches at one value; its confidence-correctness AUROC is 0.499 and 0.528, and routing by it moves selective-accuracy AUC by -0.004 and +0.037. Gemma-3 spreads its confidence over nine values, reaches AUROC 0.70, and gains +0.114 and +0.115. MedGemma's label-token probabilities do not rescue it: their validation advantage reverses where the top-20 alternatives include every class. On 1,800-patch subsets of each cohort, stratified on correctness and reweighted to the full splits, agreement across five prompt variants beats random by +0.123 and +0.106, and wording-only paraphrases give +0.100 and, externally and in direction only, +0.054; agreement's external margins over confidence do not survive slide-level clustering. Under one restructured prompt variant, MedGemma's stated confidence routes (+0.112, +0.141), so the failure is tied to a prompt chosen for macro F1.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在结直肠病理切片上零样本测试 MedGemma-27b-it 与基座 Gemma-3-27b-it 的言语化置信度能否指示回答正确性，并比较标签 token 概率、多提示一致性、措辞改写和重构提示下的置信度路由对选择性预测的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 置信度与正确性的耦合及按置信度路由，对应 LVR 中「何时停止、何时求助外部证据」的 STOP 决策信号；其报告的置信度取值坍缩与提示敏感性，可供核查把模型自评置信度当作停止或门控依据是否可靠。
